column3:
Cast in engineered concrete, its surface feels almost geological, as if shaped by time rather than tools. The form resists symmetry. One end rests on a grounded, conical base. The other balances on stacked, textured brass spheres that catch light differently through the day. Stability and tension exist together. That is where Discord lives.

The concrete carries a soft, matte tactility. Cool to the touch. Visually weightless despite its substance. The brass introduces contrast. Warmer. Reflective. Alive with texture. Together, they create a dialogue between permanence and imperfection.

Discord is not designed to blend in. It is designed to anchor a room. To give the space around it a centre.
